title: LinkedIn Thought-Leadership Post Builder
description: Create a high-signal LinkedIn post that teaches one specific lesson. Uses a strong hook, context, actionable takeaways, and a clear CTA. Optimized for skimmability and mobile reading.
content:
Act as a senior B2B content strategist.
For: {AUDIENCE} in {INDUSTRY}.
Objective: teach one useful lesson about {TOPIC} that earns saves and replies.
Inputs you’ll receive: {TOPIC}, {AUDIENCE}, {VOICE}, optional {METRIC}, {CALL_TO_ACTION}.
Deliverables: 1 post body, 3 alternate hooks, 5 hashtags.
Constraints: 180–220 words, short paras, bullets, no fluff.
---
Goal: teach {AUDIENCE} one valuable insight about {TOPIC}.
Constraints:
- Voice: {VOICE}
- Max length: 180–220 words
- Format: short paragraphs and bullets
Structure:
1) Hook line with tension or contrarian angle
2) Context: why this matters now for {AUDIENCE}
3) 3–5 actionable steps or rules
4) Micro-case or example with {METRIC} if available
5) CTA: {CALL_TO_ACTION}
Deliverables:
- Post body
- 3 alternate hooks
- 5 suggested hashtags for {INDUSTRY}

examples.CALL_TO_ACTION: Comment "framework" and I’ll DM the template

title: Carousel: Case Study Storyboard
description: Turns a customer win into a 7–10 slide carousel. Clear before/after, measurable outcomes, and a simple visual cue per slide.
content:
Act as a product marketing manager and carousel copywriter.
For: {AUDIENCE} evaluating {PRODUCT}.
Objective: turn {CUSTOMER} win into a crisp 7–10 slide story.
Inputs: {CUSTOMER}, {PRODUCT}, {AUDIENCE}, {RESULT}, {METRIC}, {CALL_TO_ACTION}.
Deliverables: slide headlines, captions, alt text.
Constraints: <= 20 words per caption, concrete numbers.
---
Slides:
1) Cover: big promise for {AUDIENCE}
2) Problem: 2–3 bullets, stakes
3) False starts: what didn't work
4) Turning point: why {PRODUCT}
5–7) Steps taken: 3–5 steps with brief captions
8) Results: before → after with numbers ({METRIC})
9) Takeaways: 3 lessons for {AUDIENCE}
10) CTA: {CALL_TO_ACTION}
Output:
- Slide headlines
- Slide captions (<= 20 words each)
- Alt text suggestions

examples.RESULT: faster pipeline visibility and forecast cadence

title: Hook Generator: 20 Scroll-Stoppers
description: Generates 20 hook options tailored to your ICP. Mixes question, stat shock, contrarian, and mini-story formats.
content:
Act as a conversion copywriter.
For: {AUDIENCE}/{ICP} on LinkedIn.
Objective: generate 20 clean, specific hooks for {TOPIC}.
Inputs: {TOPIC}, {AUDIENCE}, {ICP}.
Deliverables: 20 hooks labeled by style.
Constraints: <= 14 words, no clickbait, high clarity.
---
Hook styles to include: question, bold claim, pain-first, number/stat, myth-busting, mini-story, how-to, checklist.
Deliver:
- 20 hook lines max 14 words each
- Label each with style
- Prioritize clarity over cleverness
- Avoid clickbait
- Ensure relevance to {ICP}

title: Comment Ladder: Strategic Comment Plan
description: Produces 10 high-value comments to place under target accounts to build visibility and authority before outreach.
content:
Act as a social selling strategist.
For: {TARGET_ACCOUNTS} creators/brands.
Objective: craft comments that add insight and invite replies around {TOPIC}.
Inputs: {TARGET_ACCOUNTS}, {TOPIC}.
Deliverables: 10 comments, each with rationale and timing.
Constraints: 40–80 words, no pitching, quote the creator.
---
Guidelines:
- 10 comments, 40–80 words each
- Add 1 insight, 1 question, 1 example per comment
- Never pitch
- Reference creator's point by quoting a phrase
Deliver:
- Comment text
- Rationale for each
- Suggested timing (days of week)

title: Warm DM: Value-First Outreach
description: Polite, relevant DM sequence that references a recent post and offers a tiny, specific win. No hard pitch.
content:
Act as an SDR writing warm DMs.
For: {RECIPIENT_ROLE} at {COMPANY}.
Objective: open a conversation by offering {MICRO_OFFER} tied to {POST_LINK_OR_TOPIC}.
Inputs: {RECIPIENT_ROLE}, {COMPANY}, {POST_LINK_OR_TOPIC}, {MICRO_OFFER}.
Deliverables: 4-message sequence with personalization tokens and reasoning.
Constraints: respectful, no pressure, concrete value.
---
Sequence:
1) Connection note (<= 220 chars)
2) Day 1 follow-up with personalized value
3) Day 5 nudge with 1 concrete idea
4) Day 12 soft close
Deliver each message with:
- Copy
- Personalization token(s)
- Reason it works

examples.POST_LINK_OR_TOPIC: your post on demand capture vs demand gen
examples.MICRO_OFFER: a 3-slide audit of your LinkedIn funnel

title: Lead Magnet Teaser Post
description: High-conversion post that teases a gated asset. Emphasizes outcomes, includes skimmable bullets, and a low-friction CTA.
content:
Act as a demand gen copywriter.
For: {AUDIENCE} considering {ASSET_NAME}.
Objective: maximize comments/clicks with value-forward copy.
Inputs: {ASSET_NAME}, {OUTCOME}, {AUDIENCE}, {PAIN_POINT}, optional {METRIC}, {URL}.
Deliverables: teaser post + 2 variants (no-link, link-in-comments).
Constraints: specific bullets, clear CTA.
---
Structure:
- Hook tied to {PAIN_POINT}
- 3–5 bullets of what's inside (specific)
- 1 micro-proof (e.g., {METRIC} from pilot)
- CTA: comment keyword or link {URL}
Also deliver 2 variations: no-link version and link-in-comments version.

title: Event Promo + Reminder Sequence
description: Three posts and two reminders that move people from awareness to registration to attendance for a LinkedIn Live or webinar.
content:
Act as an events marketer.
For: {AUDIENCE} likely to attend {EVENT_NAME}.
Objective: drive registrations and show-up.
Inputs: {EVENT_NAME}, {EVENT_DATE}, {SPEAKERS}, {VALUE_PROP}.
Deliverables: 3 promo posts, reminder comments, and replay post.
Constraints: concise, outcome-led, include CTA.
---
Deliver:
- Teaser post (T-10 days)
- Deep dive post (T-5)
- Last-call post (T-1)
- Reminder comment templates
- Post-event replay post with key timestamps
Include hashtags for {INDUSTRY}.

examples.SPEAKERS: Jane Doe, VP Growth; Ravi Kumar, CMO

title: Newsletter Launch Announcement
description: Crisp announcement that frames why the newsletter exists, who it serves, what’s inside, and how often.
content:
Act as a brand comms lead.
For: {AUDIENCE}.
Objective: announce {NEWSLETTER_NAME} and earn signups.
Inputs: {NEWSLETTER_NAME}, {CADENCE}, {AUDIENCE}, {SOCIAL_PROOF}, {URL}, {VOICE_A}, {VOICE_B}.
Deliverables: 2 tone variants, clear value bullets, CTA.
Constraints: skimmable, no jargon.
---
Inside you'll get: 3–5 bullets
Proof: {SOCIAL_PROOF}
CTA: subscribe link {URL} or comment keyword
Deliver 2 tone variants: {VOICE_A}, {VOICE_B}

title: Poll With Insightful Framing
description: A poll that drives discussion, not just votes. Includes framing copy and a follow-up comment to seed insights.
content:
Act as a community builder.
For: {AUDIENCE} debating {TOPIC}.
Objective: collect signal and start a discussion.
Inputs: {TOPIC}, {QUESTION}, {OPTION_A}, {OPTION_B}, {OPTION_C}, {OPTION_D}, {METRIC_SOURCE}.
Deliverables: pre-poll copy, poll options, follow-up comment, 5 reply prompts.
Constraints: neutral framing, no leading language.
---
Pre-poll copy: context + why it matters
Follow-up comment: share your stance + 1 stat ({METRIC_SOURCE})
Add 5 prompts to encourage replies.

examples.QUESTION: What’s the best first signal of ICP intent?

title: Profile About Section Rewrite
description: Rewrites your About section to sell outcomes. Uses credibility, ICP clarity, proof, and a simple CTA.
content:
Act as a positioning consultant.
For: {ICP} who must quickly grasp your value.
Objective: rewrite About to outcomes and proof.
Inputs: {ROLE}, {ICP}, {OUTCOMES}, {PROOF_POINTS}, {CTA}.
Deliverables: 150-word and 300-word versions.
Constraints: skimmable, concrete, no buzzwords.
---
Output:
- 2 versions (150 words, 300 words)
- Skimmable lines, no jargon
- Replace duties with outcomes for {ICP}

examples.OUTCOMES: shorten time-to-pipeline, raise activation, improve CAC payback
examples.PROOF_POINTS: ex-Shopify growth, +38% activation at Acme, 3 exits

title: Headline Optimizer (10 Variants)
description: Creates 10 profile headlines that clarify role, ICP, and result. Balanced between clarity and intrigue.
content:
Act as a personal brand copywriter.
For: {ICP} quickly scanning profiles.
Objective: craft 10 clear, credible headlines.
Inputs: {ROLE}, {ICP}, {PRIMARY_RESULT}, {DIFFERENTIATOR}.
Deliverables: 10 headline options + rationale.
Constraints: <= 220 chars, minimal separators.
---
Deliver 10 options, each with a rationale.

examples.DIFFERENTIATOR: ICPs aligned scoring and GTM motion

title: Experience Bullets: Outcome-Focused (STAR)
description: Converts role duties into outcome bullets using STAR. Prioritizes metrics and transferable skills.
content:
Act as a resume strategist.
For: recruiters and hiring managers.
Objective: convert duties to outcome bullets.
Inputs: {ROLE}, {COMPANY}, {ACHIEVEMENTS}, {METRIC}.
Deliverables: 6–10 STAR bullets.
Constraints: 1 line each, start with verb, include numbers.
---
Deliver 6–10 bullets:
- Start with action verb
- Include numbers ({METRIC})
- STAR framing in one line
- Align to {ICP} relevance

examples.ACHIEVEMENTS: shipped onboarding checklist, launched A/B engine

title: Recommendation Request (Polite Template)
description: A short, respectful request that makes it easy for someone to recommend you with specific talking points.
content:
Act as a polite professional requesting a recommendation.
For: {NAME} who worked with you during {PROJECT_OR_PERIOD}.
Objective: make it easy to write a relevant rec.
Inputs: {NAME}, {PROJECT_OR_PERIOD}, {POINTS}.
Deliverables: DM version and email version + thank-you follow-up.
Constraints: respectful, specific prompts, no pressure.
---
Deliver 2 versions:
- DM (<= 500 chars)
- Email (<= 120 words)
Include thank-you follow-up.

title: Hiring Post: Role Magnet
description: A candidate-first role post. Leads with mission, impact, growth, and clear application step.
content:
Act as a talent brand marketer.
For: candidates considering {ROLE} on {TEAM}.
Objective: attract qualified applicants.
Inputs: {ROLE}, {TEAM}, {MISSION}, {COMP_INFO}, {URL}.
Deliverables: role post with hooks, hashtags.
Constraints: mission/impact first, clear apply CTA.
---
Impact areas: 3 bullets
Must-haves: 4 bullets
Nice-to-haves: 3 bullets
Apply CTA: {URL}
Provide 2 hooks and 5 hashtags.

examples.MISSION: make data pipelines 10x faster for customers

title: Job Description → LinkedIn Post
description: Turns a dry JD into a compelling LinkedIn post that speaks to outcomes and growth.
content:
Act as a recruiting copywriter.
For: {AUDIENCE} who might fit the JD.
Objective: convert {JD_SNIPPET} into an outcome-led post.
Inputs: {JD_SNIPPET}, {AUDIENCE}, application link.
Deliverables: 160–200 word post + 3 pull quotes.
Constraints: clear outcomes, growth path, single CTA.
---
Deliver:
- 160–200 word post
- 3 pull quotes from JD rewritten for impact
- 1 short CTA with application link

examples.JD_SNIPPET: own the end-to-end model lifecycle from experimentation to deployment

title: Founder Origin Story Post
description: Personal narrative that ties a founder’s backstory to the product mission without fluff.
content:
Act as a brand storyteller.
For: potential customers and partners.
Objective: connect {FOUNDER}'s story to {MISSION} credibly.
Inputs: {FOUNDER}, {MOMENT}, {PAIN_POINT}, {MISSION}, {METRIC}, {CALL_TO_ACTION}.
Deliverables: narrative post with CTA.
Constraints: vivid scene, real stakes, one clear lesson.
---
Structure:
- Cold open scene (1–2 lines)
- The problem and stakes
- The first build and lesson
- Today’s impact with {METRIC}
- CTA: {CALL_TO_ACTION}

examples.MOMENT: a failed pilot that took down staging

title: Co-Marketing Announcement
description: Joint post announcing a partnership. Clarifies value for users, joint activities, and next steps.
content:

Objective: announce partnership and value clearly.
Inputs: {PARTNER_A}, {PARTNER_B}, {VALUE_PROP}, {ACTIVITIES}, {TIMELINE}, {CALL_TO_ACTION}.
Deliverables: announcement post in 2 tones.
Constraints: user benefits first, minimal jargon.
---
Deliver two tones: formal and friendly.

examples.VALUE_PROP: clean event data into modeled metrics in days
examples.ACTIVITIES: joint webinar, shared playbook, co-sell path

title: Social Proof Thread
description: Short post plus a comment thread that compiles 5 proof points with links or visuals.
content:
Act as a credibility strategist.
For: prospects on the fence.
Objective: compile proofs that reduce risk.
Inputs: {PROOFS} list with quotes/screens/metrics and {URL_X}.
Deliverables: main post + 5 proof comments with takeaways.
Constraints: keep claims specific and sourced.
---
Deliver:
- Post that frames the proof theme
- 5 comments, each highlighting one proof with takeaway and link {URL_X}
- 5 hashtags

examples.PROOFS: G2 awards, customer quotes, public dashboards, case studies, analyst notes

title: Launch Day Pack: Teaser, Launch, Demo
description: Three coordinated posts that build to launch day and drive demo requests.
content:
Act as a product marketer.
For: {ICP} considering {PRODUCT}.
Objective: sequence posts to maximize launch ROI.
Inputs: {PRODUCT}, {ICP}, {DEMO_LINK}, {DOCS_LINK}, beta {METRIC}.
Deliverables: teaser, launch, and demo posts with CTAs.
Constraints: concrete outcomes, one idea per post.
---
Deliver:
- Teaser (T-3): problem-first with curiosity
- Launch (T0): what’s new, who for, {METRIC} from beta
- Demo (T+2): invite with agenda bullets
All include CTA and hashtags.

title: Customer Win: Narrative Post
description: Human story of a customer win. Focuses on stakes, decision, small moments, and results.

examples.MOMENT: switch from ebook to product mini-demo

title: Myth vs Fact Carousel
description: Educational carousel that corrects 6 common myths for your industry with short, evidence-backed facts.
content:
Act as an industry educator.
For: {AUDIENCE} confused about {TOPIC}.
Objective: correct 6 myths with concise facts and sources.
Inputs: {TOPIC}, {AUDIENCE}, sources {SOURCE}.
Deliverables: slide headlines and captions.
Constraints: <= 20 words per fact, cite source.
---
Slides 1–7:
- 6 myths → concise fact + why it matters
- 1 resource or stat each ({SOURCE})
- Final slide CTA for {CALL_TO_ACTION}

examples.CALL_TO_ACTION: Save for your next team training

title: Contrarian Take With Evidence
description: Well-reasoned contrarian post. Avoids hot takes, uses data and example, ends with an open question.
content:
Act as a thoughtful industry analyst.
For: {AUDIENCE} saturated with the {NORM} opinion.
Objective: present {CLAIM} with evidence and invite debate.
Inputs: {CLAIM}, {NORM}, {EVIDENCE}, {METRIC}, {EXAMPLE}, {QUESTION}, {VOICE}.
Deliverables: 1 contrarian post with open question.
Constraints: respectful tone, cite sources, actionable takeaway.
---
Question to audience: {QUESTION}

examples.EXAMPLE: product-led sales motion in mid-market SaaS
examples.QUESTION: Where does this break in enterprise?

title: LinkedIn Live Promo Script
description: Short script plus post copy for a 45–60s video promoting your upcoming LinkedIn Live.
content:
Act as a video scriptwriter.
For: {AUDIENCE} deciding to attend {EVENT_NAME}.
Objective: record a 45–60s promo and supporting post.
Inputs: {EVENT_NAME}, {AUDIENCE}, {URL}.
Deliverables: 5 hooks, script beats, and post caption.
Constraints: punchy, camera-ready lines, clear CTA.
---
Script beats:
1) Problem hook
2) What you’ll learn (3 bullets)
3) Guest intro
4) When and where
5) CTA: set reminder {URL}
Also provide post caption and 5 hooks.

title: Hashtag Bank Builder
description: Generates a rotating bank of 30–45 hashtags grouped by intent and size for your niche.
content:
Act as a social SEO specialist.
For: creators in {INDUSTRY} reaching {AUDIENCE}.
Objective: build a rotating hashtag bank.
Inputs: {INDUSTRY}, {AUDIENCE}, {TOPIC}.
Deliverables: 3 groups (niche/mid/broad) and 5 bundles.
Constraints: relevant, non-spammy, mixed sizes.
---
Deliver:
- 3 groups: niche, mid, broad
- 10–15 hashtags per group
- Usage guidance and rotation plan
- 5 example bundles (mix of 3–5 each)

title: Weekly LinkedIn Content Calendar
description: One-week calendar for LinkedIn only. Balances value posts, proof, engagement, and soft pitch.
content:
Act as a content operations planner.
For: {ICP} promoting {OFFER} across {THEMES}.
Objective: produce a 7-day LinkedIn plan with balance and backups.
Inputs: {ICP}, {THEMES}, {OFFER}.
Deliverables: 7-day schedule with hooks, outline, CTA, hashtags, plus 3 backups.
Constraints: one idea per post, specific outcomes.
---
Deliver a 7-day plan:
- Day name
- Post type (teach, story, proof, poll, carousel, live)
- Hook line
- 3 bullets outline
- CTA
- Hashtag bundle
Also include 3 backup ideas.

title: SEO Content Brief Generator
description: Creates a complete content brief for a target keyword: search intent, angle, outline, entities, questions, and on-page requirements.
content:
Act as a senior SEO strategist.
Goal: create a content brief that can rank for {PRIMARY_KEYWORD} in {COUNTRY} for {AUDIENCE}.
Inputs: {PRIMARY_KEYWORD}, {COUNTRY}, {AUDIENCE}, {BUYING_STAGE}, competitors {COMPETITORS}.
Deliverables:
- Search intent and reader goal
- Primary angle and promise
- SERP synopsis (top 5) with gaps
- H2/H3 outline with talking points
- Required entities (NLP) and synonyms
- Questions to answer (PAAs)
- On-page specs: title, meta, URL, word-count range
- Internal link targets and anchor ideas
Constraints: clarity over jargon, bullets preferred.

title: Keyword Cluster Builder
description: Groups a seed keyword into tightly themed clusters with page-type recommendations and priority scoring.
content:
Act as an SEO keyword analyst.
Task: cluster keywords around {SEED_KEYWORD} for {INDUSTRY}.
Inputs: {SEED_KEYWORD}, {INDUSTRY}, geo {COUNTRY}, business goal {GOAL}.
Deliver:
- 6–12 clusters with representative head term
- Each cluster: 8–20 supporting keywords
- Intent tag (info/comp/trans/local)
- Suggested page type (guide, list, comparison, category, PDP, tool)
- Priority score using {CRITERIA} (volume, difficulty, business fit)
- Sample title for each cluster page
Constraints: no overlapping clusters; keep semantic tightness high.

title: SERP Teardown and Gap Analysis
description: Audits the current SERP for the target query. Extracts patterns, entity coverage, angles, and content gaps to exploit.
content:
Act as a SERP analyst.
Objective: analyze the top results for {PRIMARY_KEYWORD} in {COUNTRY}.
Inputs: {PRIMARY_KEYWORD}, {COUNTRY}, {DEVICE}.
Output:
- Intent type and SERP features present
- Top 10 result angles, content formats, and E-E-A-T signals
- Entities frequently mentioned vs missing
- Gap opportunities we can own
- Recommended angle and outline delta vs incumbents
- CTR plays for title/meta
Constraints: concise bullets, actionable next steps.

title: Title & Meta Description Optimizer
description: Generates 5 tested variants of SEO title tags and meta descriptions tuned for intent, pixel width, and CTR.
content:
Act as a CTR-focused SEO copywriter.
Inputs: {PRIMARY_KEYWORD}, {SEARCH_INTENT}, {BRAND}, {MAX_TITLE_PIXELS}, {MAX_META_CHARS}.
Deliver:
- 5 title options within {MAX_TITLE_PIXELS} px
- 5 meta descriptions within {MAX_META_CHARS} chars
- Note the angle used (benefit, numbers, novelty, authority, objection)
- Include the keyword naturally and front-load value
Constraints: no clickbait; readable on mobile.

title: Featured Snippet Playbook
description: Designs a snippet-ready answer block with format guidance to win paragraph, list, or table snippets.
content:
Act as an SEO snippet tactician.
Goal: earn the featured snippet for {PRIMARY_KEYWORD}.
Inputs: {PRIMARY_KEYWORD}, {SNIPPET_TYPE}, {TARGET_ANGLE}.
Deliver:
- Snippet-ready answer (40–55 words for paragraph OR 6–8 items for list/table)
- Supporting context block
- Markup and placement guidance (H2/H3, list/table usage)
- Internal link to supporting page
- Title/meta tuned for snippet ownership
Constraints: concise, authoritative tone; include defining sentence if term-based.

title: People Also Ask Mining
description: Expands a page with PAA questions and concise answers to deepen topical coverage and win long-tail.
content:
Act as a topical depth strategist.
Task: mine PAA questions for {PRIMARY_KEYWORD} and produce concise answers.
Inputs: {PRIMARY_KEYWORD}, {COUNTRY}, {COUNT}.
Deliver:
- {COUNT} PAA questions grouped by subtopic
- 40–60 word answer for each
- Where to place in article (section mapping)
- Markup recommendation (H3 + short paragraph or list)
- Internal links candidates
Constraints: avoid redundancy; ensure semantic progression.

title: Internal Linking Blueprint
description: Builds a hub-and-spoke internal linking plan with anchors and insertion points to boost topical authority.
content:
Act as an internal linking architect.
Inputs: {HUB_TOPIC}, {SPOKES} list, site section {SECTION}.
Deliver:
- Hub page purpose and target keyword
- Spokes list with primary and secondary anchors
- Insertion points: source URL and paragraph cue
- Link ratios and rel guidance
- Measurement plan: {KPIS}
Constraints: avoid over-optimization; maintain UX.

examples.SPOKES: editorial calendar, content audit, buyer personas, content brief, distribution

title: Topical Map & Information Architecture
description: Designs a scalable topical map with categories, pillar pages, supporting articles, and URL patterns.
content:
Act as an SEO information architect.
Goal: propose a topical map for {THEME} that supports {BUSINESS_GOAL}.
Inputs: {THEME}, {BUSINESS_GOAL}, {COUNTRY}, {URL_PATTERN}.
Deliver:
- 5–8 pillars with rationale
- 6–12 supports per pillar
- URL scheme using {URL_PATTERN}
- Breadcrumbs and nav recommendations
- Content sequencing over {QUARTERS} quarters
Constraints: avoid cannibalization; each page has unique intent.

title: Content Refresh Brief
description: Audits an existing URL and provides a surgical refresh plan to regain rankings and CTR.
content:
Act as a content refresh specialist.
Inputs: {URL}, target {PRIMARY_KEYWORD}, competitor set {COMPETITORS}.
Deliver:
- Current gaps vs top 5
- Sections to add, merge, remove
- Entity and question coverage to include
- Title/meta rewrite variants
- Internal link updates
- Success criteria and timeline
Constraints: minimal structural changes; aim for +{CTR_TARGET} CTR and +{RANK_TARGET} rank positions.

title: Technical SEO Audit Checklist (Actionable)
description: Creates an actionable crawl-based checklist with prioritized fixes and expected impact.
content:
Act as a technical SEO lead.
Inputs: crawl summary {CRAWL_SUMMARY}, CMS {CMS}, site size {URL_COUNT}.
Deliver:
- Issues by category: crawlability, indexation, canonicalization, rendering, speed, structured data, hreflang
- Steps to reproduce and fix for {CMS}
- Priority (P0–P2) and expected impact
- Owner and effort estimate
- Validation method
Constraints: pragmatic; focus on what moves {BUSINESS_GOAL}.

examples.CRAWL_SUMMARY: 12k URLs, 1.3k 404s, thin content on 400 URLs, duplicate titles on 320 URLs

title: Server Log Insights Summary
description: Translates raw server log insights into SEO actions: crawl budget waste, priority paths, and bot anomalies.
content:
Act as a log file analyst.
Inputs: {DATE_RANGE}, {TOP_FOLDERS}, anomalies {NOTES}.
Deliver:
- Crawl frequency by folder
- Waste hotspots and fixes
- Priority pages under-crawled
- Bot anomalies and blocks
- Next steps to rebalance crawl budget
Constraints: 1-page summary; charts optional; focus on decisions.

title: Page Speed Remediation Plan
description: Provides a prioritized plan to hit Core Web Vitals across templates with dev-ready tasks.
content:
Act as a performance SEO.
Inputs: {TEMPLATES} list, current vitals {VITALS}, tech {STACK}.
Deliver:
- Template-level issues and fixes (LCP, CLS, INP)
- Asset budget targets
- Lazy-load and preconnect plan
- Test/rollout sequence
- Monitoring setup
Constraints: measurable goals: LCP <= {LCP_TARGET}s, CLS <= {CLS_TARGET}, INP <= {INP_TARGET}ms.

title: Schema Markup Plan
description: Recommends schema types per template with JSON-LD examples and validation notes.
content:
Act as a structured data specialist.
Inputs: {TEMPLATES}, business type {BUSINESS_TYPE}.
Deliver:
- Schema types per template
- Required and recommended properties
- JSON-LD examples to adapt
- Validation and monitoring checklist
Constraints: follow Google guidelines; avoid spammy markup.

title: E-E-A-T Author & Page Signals
description: Creates author box copy, page trust elements, and sourcing plan to strengthen E-E-A-T.
content:
Act as an E-E-A-T consultant.
Inputs: {AUTHOR_NAME}, {AUTHOR_CREDENTIALS}, {TOPIC}, site {BRAND}.
Deliver:
- Author bio (short/long) with credentials
- Page-level trust elements checklist
- Source list and citation model
- Organization and review schema notes
Constraints: verifiable claims only; add links to profiles and citations.

examples.AUTHOR_CREDENTIALS: PhD in Information Retrieval, ex-Google Search

title: Local SEO Profile Optimizer
description: Optimizes Google Business Profile and key citations with service-area and photo strategy.
content:
Act as a local SEO specialist.
Inputs: {BUSINESS_NAME}, {CITY}, {SERVICES}, {PHONE}, {URL}.
Deliver:
- GBP categories and attributes
- Service area config
- Products/services list with copy
- Photo and post plan (4 weeks)
- Citation list and NAP format
Constraints: accurate NAP; avoid category stuffing.

title: GBP Posts & Q/A Calendar
description: Builds a 4-week Google Business Profile content plan with Q&A and offer posts.
content:
Act as a local content planner.
Inputs: {BUSINESS_NAME}, {CITY}, {SERVICES}, {PROMOS}.
Deliver:
- 4-week post calendar (events, offers, updates)
- Q&A pairs to seed
- UTM-tagged URLs
- Photo suggestions per post
Constraints: each post <= 1,500 chars; clear CTA.

title: Linkable Asset Ideation
description: Generates 10 data-backed asset ideas designed to attract natural links in your niche.
content:
Act as a digital PR strategist.
Inputs: {INDUSTRY}, {AUDIENCE}, {UNIQUE_DATA_SOURCES}.
Deliver:
- 10 linkable asset concepts (reports, indices, tools, maps)
- Data sources and methodology notes
- Hook angles and outreach targets
- Lightweight production plan
Constraints: novelty and credibility over volume.

title: Digital PR Pitch Pack
description: Crafts 3 email pitches and 2 follow-ups per idea with angle personalization and subject lines.
content:
Act as a PR copywriter.
Inputs: {ASSET_TITLE}, {TARGET_PUBLICATIONS}, {SPOKESPERSON}, {KEY_STAT}.
Deliver:
- 3 pitch angles with subject lines
- 2 follow-ups per angle
- Quote snippets from {SPOKESPERSON}
- Personalization tokens by publication
